title: Ever Works — App spec (kind: app)
description: The `spec` block of a `.works/works.yml` whose kind is `app`, and the whole document of a stand-alone App spec. Structure only: the reference and cross-field rules are validated by the platform. Keys starting with `x-` are allowed at any depth and ignored.

kind.description: Repeats the root `kind`; must equal it when both are present (§1:64).

source.description: Where the repository came from (§5); required in `data-repository` mode.

relation.description: How the App Work relates to its repository (§5:123): fork · private-copy · link. Required.

upstream.description: The repository followed (§5:124); forbidden when `relation` is `link` (R13).

repo.description: The upstream repository, `owner/repo` (§5:124); required unless `relation` is `link`.

defaultBranch.description: The upstream branch to follow (§5:125); default: the upstream default at creation.

branch.description: The branch built and deployed (§5:126); default: the Work Repository default branch.

version.description: The Blueprint version (§6:138): a semantic version `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`. Required.

sha.description: The pinned Blueprint commit (§6:140): 40 lowercase hex characters. Required.

spdx.description: An SPDX expression ≤ 200 characters (§7:150): `MIT`, `AGPL-3.0-only`, `MIT OR Apache-2.0`.

class.description: The declared licence class (§7:151): green · amber · red · unknown.

source.description: Where the declaration came from (§7:152): detected · blueprint · user.

notice.description: Trademark / attribution notice shown with the app, ≤ 500 characters (§7:153).

sourceOfferUrl.description: Where network users obtain the source when the Work Repository is private (§7:154, R27).

name.description: How the app is displayed, 1–80 characters (§8:163); default: the Work name.

protectedPaths.description: Paths agents may not change (§8:164), at most 50 globs; default: [].

items.description: Glob (schema.md §0): a RelPath of 1–200 characters that may contain `*`, `**` or `?`.

build.description: How the image is produced (§9); required when `components` is non-empty.

strategy.description: How the image is produced (§9:170): dockerfile · image · auto · none. Required when `components` is non-empty; `none` when it is empty. No builder name (R-13).

dockerfile.description: The Dockerfile path, only with `strategy: dockerfile` (§9:171); default: `Dockerfile`.

context.description: The build context, only with `dockerfile` or `auto` (§9:172); default: `.`.

target.description: The Dockerfile target stage, only with `strategy: dockerfile` (§9:173).

image.description: The prebuilt image, required with `strategy: image` (§9:174); a tag-only reference warns (R19).

args.description: At most 50 build arguments (§9:175); default: []. Never literal secrets (R10).

value.description: A literal build-argument value ≤ 1000 characters (§9:175); never a secret (R10).

fromEnv.description: Names an `env` entry that must be `build` or `both` (§9:175); a secret one only warns (R11).

services.description: At most 5 ephemeral build-only services (§9:176); default: [].

env.description: At most 20 environment entries for the service (§9:176).

name.description: The variable name of a build service’s environment entry (§9:176).

value.description: The value of a build service’s environment entry (§9:176).

resources.description: The build runner’s resources (§9:177-179); defaults: cpu 2, memory 7Gi, timeout 60.

cpu.description: Build-runner CPU cores, a number 1–16 (§9:177); default: 2.

components.description: At most 10 components (§10); at least one when `build.strategy` ≠ `none` (R2).

name.description: A DNS-label name, unique among components (§10:194, R4). Required.

command.description: Image entrypoint override, ≤ 20 items × 1000 characters (§10:196); default: the image entrypoint.

args.description: Image cmd override, ≤ 50 items × 1000 characters (§10:197); default: the image cmd.

port.description: The container port, 1–65535 (§10:199). Required for `web` (R1), forbidden for `worker`.

writableRootFilesystem.description: Whether the root filesystem is writable (§10:201); default: false.

runAsUser.description: The numeric uid the container runs as, 1–4294967294 (§10:202, APW06-G26); default: absent — the image’s own user.

probes.description: The component’s probes (§10:203); `web` defaults to a TCP readiness probe.

memoryLimit.description: The memory limit, ≥ `memory` (§10:207, R17); default: `2 × memory`.

volumes.description: At most 5 volumes (§10:208); default: []. A component with volumes is limited to one replica (R18).

path.description: An absolute mount path of at most 255 characters (§10:208). Required.

backup.description: Whether the volume is backed up (§10:208); default: true.

dependencies.description: The managed services the app needs (§11).

directUrl.description: Also provide a non-pooled URL (§11:220); default: false.

extensions.description: At most 10 Postgres extensions (§11:221); default: []. Availability warns `extension_unavailable`.

buckets.description: The buckets to create, 1–10 unique names (§11:225). Required.

items.description: Name (schema.md §0): a DNS label of 1–32 characters, lowercase, digits and dashes only.

publicBuckets.description: Buckets that are publicly readable, a subset of `buckets` (§11:226); default: [].

items.description: Name (schema.md §0): a DNS label of 1–32 characters, lowercase, digits and dashes only.

required.description: Whether SMTP is required before deploying (§11:227); default: false.

env.description: At most 200 env entries (§12), names unique (R4).

secret.description: Stored encrypted, never logged or returned (§12:247, Constitution VII); default: false.

phase.description: When the value exists (§12:248): runtime · build · both; default: `runtime`.

description.description: What the value is for, ≤ 300 characters (§12:249).

value.description: A literal value ≤ 4096 characters (§12:250); forbidden when `secret: true` (R8).

template.description: A ≤ 2048-character template over the same references plus `env.<NAME>` (§12:252).

kind.description: The generator (§12:261): base64 · hex · chars · uuid · keypair. Required.

type.description: The key type (§12:272): ed25519 · ec-p256 · rsa-2048 · rsa-4096; default: `ed25519`.

format.description: The storage format (§12:273, R-11): pem · base64url-raw · pkcs12; default: `pem`.

passwordEnv.description: Required with `format: pkcs12`, forbidden otherwise (§12:274, R26).

rotate.description: When the value is replaced (§12:266): `never` is the only value in appSpecVersion 1.

validate.description: Checks applied to the value (§12:254, R9).

pattern.description: An RE2 pattern of at most 500 characters (§12:254); look-around is `pattern_unsupported`.

prompt.description: Ask for the value at setup (§12:255).

required.description: Whether the answer is required (§12:255); default: true.

example.description: An example answer ≤ 200 characters (§12:255); secret-scanned — a match is `prompt_example_secret`.

name.description: The job name, unique among jobs (§13:319, R4). Required.

component.description: Must name a component (§13:321, R14); default: `domains.primaryComponent`.

http.description: The HTTP request the job makes (§13:323-328).

method.description: GET · POST · PUT · PATCH · DELETE (§13:323); default: `POST`.

body.description: A JSON body of at most 16 KiB serialized (§13:325).

authEnv.description: Names a `secret: true` env entry, sent in `Authorization` (§13:326, R15).

expect.description: What the request must answer with (§13:328).

cron.description: At most 20 cron entries (§14), names unique (R4).

name.description: The cron name, unique among cron entries (§14:338, R4). Required.

schedule.description: A five-field cron expression, UTC (§14:339). Required; unparsable is `cron_invalid`.

http.description: The HTTP request the fire makes (§14:341, as in §13).

method.description: GET · POST · PUT · PATCH · DELETE (§13:323); default: `POST`.

body.description: A JSON body of at most 16 KiB serialized (§13:325).

authEnv.description: Names a `secret: true` env entry, sent in `Authorization` (§13:326, R15).

expect.description: What the request must answer with (§13:328).

concurrency.description: What Kubernetes does when a fire is still running (§14:343): forbid · allow; default: `forbid`.

primaryComponent.description: The web component that serves the public URL (§15:349, R3); default: the only `web` component.

publicUrlEnv.description: At most 10 `env` entries that hold the public URL (§15:350, R16); default: [].

onChange.description: What a public-domain change requires (§15:351): restart · rebuild; default: `restart`.

needsHairpin.description: The app calls its own public URL from the server side (§15:352); default: false.

smoke.description: At most 20 smoke checks (§16), names unique (R4).

name.description: The smoke check name, unique among smoke checks (§16:355, R4). Required.

body.description: A JSON body of at most 16 KiB, `POST` only (§16:363).

component.description: Must be a `web` component (§16:364, R14); default: `domains.primaryComponent`.

expect.description: What the response must look like (§16:365-368).

bodyContains.description: At most 5 strings the body must contain, ≤ 200 characters each (§16:366); default: [].

bodyNotContains.description: At most 5 strings the body must not contain, ≤ 200 characters each (§16:367); default: [].

maxLatencyMs.description: The latency budget in milliseconds, 100–60000 (§16:368); default: 10000.

name.description: The check name, unique among checks (§17:377, R4). Required.

command.description: The command to run, 1–500 characters with no control characters (§17:378). Required.

required.description: Whether the check gates a Task (§17:379); default: true; false warns `advisory_check`.

agents.description: Agent instructions for Tasks on this App Work (§18).

items.description: RelPath (schema.md §0): 1–255 characters, relative, no `..` segment, not under `.git/`.

maxPullRequestChangedLines.description: The largest pull request, in changed lines, 50–5000 (§18:387); default: 500.

maxPullRequestChangedFiles.description: The largest pull request, in changed files, 1–500 (§18:388); default: 50.

requireHumanMergePaths.description: Paths only a person may merge (§18:389, CONTRACTS §1): at most 50 globs; default: [].

items.description: Glob (schema.md §0): a RelPath of 1–200 characters that may contain `*`, `**` or `?`.

upstreamSync.description: How the fork follows its upstream (§19).

enabled.description: Whether upstream sync runs (§19:397); default: true.

schedule.description: A five-field cron expression (§19:398); default: `0 6 * * 1`; ≥ 60 minutes apart (R21).

upstreamPullRequests.description: The pull requests the platform opens upstream (§20).

enabled.description: Whether upstream pull requests are opened (§20:406); default: false.

requireApproval.description: Only `true` is valid (§20:407, R12); default: true.

maxOpen.description: At most this many open, 1–10 (§20:408); default: 3.

autoReprovision.description: Re-provision automatically when an Upstream sync breaks the smoke tests (§20:414); default: false.
